consequence.statement: The --no-proxy flag now correctly stores its value in the intended variable, fixing the previous bug where it was stored in the wrong variable.

original.statement: The --no-proxy CLI flag now correctly stores its value in the proper variable.

decision.reason: [ev-74fec6f20224] is only a bug-fix changelog line: the CLI stored the --no-proxy value in the wrong variable, and that is now fixed. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so a mandatory-work kind is not supported. Anyone who sets --no-proxy will see the CLI behave differently after the fix, so behavior-change (review) is the conservative fit. The evidence does not say what the bug actually did before, so this is not stated directly and confidence is low.
